reviews: Security and privacy review of cache contents and redaction guarantees
Validation correctness review of dependency coverage, invalidation, and fail-toward-run behavior

findings.summary: RESOLVED. .projectops/validation-cache/ is now gitignored at commit f9f6942. Cache entries are disposable local state and will no longer appear in git status or be accidentally committed. Previous finding from run 7ec1ef74 is closed.

Cache entry schema is correctly minimal: schemaVersion, validator, key (64-char hex SHA-256), passed (boolean), errorCount (integer), createdAt, lastUsedAt. buildEntry produces only these fields. validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs checks against JWT, sk_live_, sk_test_, sk-proj-, sk-ant-, ghp_, AKIA patterns. No file contents, credentials, or provider data stored. PASS.

hashDirectory excludes node_modules, .git, target, and validation-cache. No raw file contents stored — only SHA-256 hashes. input-map.cjs paths are relative and validated against absolute/parent-traversal by the correctness validator. PASS.

Fail-toward-run behavior verified: computeCacheKey returns coverage='none' for empty inputPaths, coverage='partial' for missing/unreadable inputs, null for unreadable source or lib. checkValidatorCache returns null for null keyResult, non-full coverage, wrong validator name, key mismatch, expired entries, NaN age. readEntry returns null for non-JSON, wrong schemaVersion, missing required fields. Every ambiguous condition runs the validator. PASS.

Deletion safety verified: clear() uses fs.rmSync with recursive+force. cached-runner.cjs falls through to running each validator on any cache miss. validate-all.cjs is unchanged and remains the authoritative full runner. The cached runner is documented as an alternative, not a replacement. PASS.

Module registry sync: validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs mechanically extracts MODULES arrays from both validate-all.cjs and cached-runner.cjs and compares element-by-element. Any mismatch fails the validator. Both lists are 115 entries, identical. PASS.

Input map coverage: every key in the input map is checked against the validate-all module set; unknown entries fail. Paths validated as relative with no parent traversal. Validators NOT in the input map get coverage='none' and always run (fail-toward-run for unknown dependency coverage). PASS.

Suite-level fast path requires clean git tree AND matching HEAD + environment key AND non-expired entry AND correct result count AND every expected module present. gitState filters cache directory changes from cleanliness check to prevent self-defeating cycle. Full uncached validation (validate-all.cjs) is not weakened. PASS.

Benchmark ran and passed in this session (evidence check 'speed-benchmark', exitCode 0, at 2026-09-04T14:36:29.721Z). Suite cache check 85ms (target <=2000ms PASS). Full cached run: all 141 modules PASS. Environment: win32/x64, Node v24.14.1, Windows_NT 10.0.26200, 13th Gen Intel i5-13420H, 12 cores, 15.7 GB RAM. PASS.

Lifecycle management: 1GB cap with LRU eviction, 7-day unused-entry expiry, maintenance runs after each cached-runner invocation. Entry sizes ~280 bytes; at 141 validators total cache well under 100KB. PASS.

RESOLVED by evidence: the loop's configured checks ran all validators for this session (validation-cache-f9f69428a737-4a4dd30f). validate-no-secrets passed (exitCode 0, at 2026-09-04T14:34:43.077Z), core-tests 682 passed, agent-tests passed, agent-typecheck passed, speed-benchmark passed (exitCode 0, suite cache check 85ms). The worker could not run them directly due to tool-permission denial, but the loop is the authoritative execution path and the evidence record proves all checks passed.
